The matrix version in force at the release date of 30 November 2026 is PM-2026.12 and the masking version is MASK-SIT-01; a later version reaches this page only through rwb.access.AccessPolicyChanged.v1. The field IDs of this slice are DF-PTY-007, DF-PTY-008 and DF-PTY-016; any other field ID is accepted as data and is marked masked when no row covers it.
